caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object resembling a writing desk or bookstand with an extended flat work surface. The main structure is composed of rectangular panels forming the sides, with side and back panels set higher than the front and open at the front. The surface inside the structure is covered in a deep green material, possibly felt or velvet. The back panel features intricate carved or cut-out detailing with curved and interlocking designs, and a round, raised element at the center. The wood is rendered in brown tones with shading to suggest depth and grain, while the green surface has a subtle texture. The object is set against a plain, light beige background with no other objects present. There is a signature or writing in small text at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Writing Desk
